classification.difficultyReason: Read supplied intersections and integrate the difference between labelled polynomial curves.

content.prompt: Find the area of the shaded region in each diagram below:

spec.description: Arrowed axes, line and parabola, labelled positive intersection and shaded first-quadrant region; no grid or numeric axis ticks.
spec.answerVisibility: All plotted curves, labels and shading are permanent student givens.

spec.description: Line and cubic extend on both sides of the origin; only their positive enclosed region is shaded. No grid or numeric axis ticks.
spec.answerVisibility: All plotted curves, labels and shading are permanent student givens.

spec.description: Line and quartic with both quartic branches visible, labelled intersection and positive shaded region. No grid or numeric axis ticks.
spec.answerVisibility: All plotted curves, labels and shading are permanent student givens.

spec.description: Parabola and cubic through the origin and labelled intersection, shaded between the positive branches. No grid or numeric axis ticks.
spec.answerVisibility: All plotted curves, labels and shading are permanent student givens.

spec.description: Even-power curves with visible left-hand branches and shading confined to the positive enclosed region. No grid or numeric axis ticks.
spec.answerVisibility: All plotted curves, labels and shading are permanent student givens.

spec.description: Arrowed axes and parabola; line segment joins labelled intersections. The enclosed region is shaded. No grid or numeric axis ticks.
spec.answerVisibility: Both intersection coordinates, equations and shaded region are permanent student givens.

spec.description: Descending line segment and upward parabola with vertex above the x-axis, two labelled intersections and shaded enclosed region. No grid or numeric axis ticks.
spec.answerVisibility: Both intersection coordinates, equations and shaded region are permanent student givens.

spec.description: Downward parabola and rising line, both extending beyond labelled intersections, with their enclosed region shaded. No grid or numeric axis ticks.
spec.answerVisibility: Both intersection coordinates, equations and shaded region are permanent student givens.
